sheet_attempts.SE:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target reference1 is the ACTUAL CURRENT eight-frame walking sheet from the game. Reference2 is the side walking sheet showing the desired relaxed arm style and timing. Correct ONLY both arms (sleeves, elbows, forearms, hands) of the eight poses in reference1 so their swing matches the side walk, rotated into the existing view.
FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, nose points viewer RIGHT. Correct the belly-height bent elbow pose: arms must hang and swing in relaxed shallow arcs beside the body, not hold fists near the abdomen.
Keep exact face, hair, head, torso, vest, pouch, hips, LEGS and SHOES for each corresponding frame of reference1. Preserve their exact position, scale and stance, do NOT replace the walk poses or turn the camera. Same adult proportions, matte pale warm cel colors and fine brown linework. Do not redesign clothes or change body width.
Arm rule: gentle relaxed elbow bend about15-25degrees, same as reference2, NOT a90degree elbow bent up at the belly, NOT a running arm. Loose natural hands, not emphatic clenched fists. Shoulders swing forward/backward from the joint rather than hands jittering in place. When one anatomical arm swings forward the other swings backward, opposite to the respective leg. Arms must visibly reverse their lead across the cycle, not stay frozen in one pose.
Keep phases aligned to reference2's corresponding eightframes; firstrow shows one leading arm, secondrow switches to the opposite leading arm and returns towardstart. Each arm should pass near vertical in a passing pose and extend in a shallow arc at contacts. Never paste the same arm angle into all8cells.
EXACT4columns2rows, eight complete figures, same cell centers and original canvas aspect 2560x1448, no crop, feet registered at same positions as reference1. Transparent RGBA alpha0 outside, no background/groundshadow/glow/specks/grid/text. Preserve fully opaque cloth and narrow clean antialiasing only.
